notes.material: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5. ATTENTION: the V-free direction of 01_02 2.5 was chosen for ZONE 1; whether its perimeter also covers this Zone-3 part is an OPEN verdict (00_07 HW.3), so 4V here is the standing baseline, not a settled choice. The material SPECIFICATION follows the process route below and is therefore not fixed here: printed -> ASTM F2924 (AM powder bed fusion); machined from wrought bar -> a wrought Grade-5 spec, to be NAMED when the route is fixed rather than guessed now (00_06 0 Validation Gate)
notes.process: SLM/DMLS or CNC (01_01 §3 step 3 — flat/simple shank, roughness less critical here than the catalytic face); build tip-down, leading-ramp-down (01_02 §1.6) if SLM
notes.post_process: DIN-471 retaining-ring groove — CNC post-DMLS (§4.3 B, +15 min/anchor)
notes.surface_finish: As-printed or as-machined, NOT etched - the mandatory production ORDER of 01_02 1.3 (print+HIP -> hot press-fit assembly Ti/PEEK/Ti -> EAAE -> dehydrogenation bake) puts this surface inside the PEEK joint before the anchor is etched. The catalytic-face finish of the flange (01_02 1.2, EAAE dual-scale) belongs to cem/cathode_flange.json and does NOT extend to this shank. (The consequence is ours; the ORDER is canon.) ATTENTION - this is a CONSEQUENCE, not an instruction, and canon protects every other un-etched surface by an EXPLICIT MASKING line instead (01_02 1.3 Step 7 masks two faces; 02_02 1.2 masks the whole anchor bar the bus terminus), while 01_02 1.3 Step 4 claims the etch reaches the WHOLE surface uniformly. So if this part is etched BEFORE assembly, or if the joint is not a reliable mask, a masking line is needed and none exists yet (00_07 HW.1).
notes.coating_restriction: NOT SPECIFIED, and deliberately so: the 01_02 3.6 map covers the flange catalytic face, the outer jacket and the pogo pad - this press-fit shank is on none of those rows. Apply nothing without a verdict; the constraint here is FIT, not DET (any coating of thickness t adds 2t of DIAMETRAL interference to a band specified in micrometres - 01_01 4.2 gives the class and defers the numbers to the Lame computation (5-34 um, tools/in_silico/lib/constants.py)). The selective Hard-Gold ENIG of 02_02 1.2 belongs to the flange pogo face, NOT to this part
notes.lattice_spec: Not applicable - solid shank with a central bus channel, no lattice
notes.inspection: Barb tooth geometry MEASURED against 01_01 4.3 (alpha/beta + h specified, base DERIVED, acceptance 0.40-0.60 mm); opposite ratchet lean to the Zone-1 end. DIN-471 groove to the real standard dimensions for this shaft diameter, CNC after printing. Bus channel diameter must accept the structural liner (01_01 1.4). ATTENTION: shank diameter is an HW.8 PLACEHOLDER, not canon - do not treat it as a frozen acceptance dimension. Pull-out retention and the PEEK 150 C click-fit are FEA + bench (00_07 HW.3.IS), NOT drawing acceptance lines
